title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: A boy at an inn finds a dead pirate's map and joins an expedition to find buried treasure. The ship's cook, charming and friendly, is not what he seems.
readIf: you want the classic pirate adventure, with a cunning villain you cannot help liking.
skipIf: you want much female presence; this is a boys' adventure of its time.

pairings.reason: Another treasure hunt that sends an unlikely hero off with a rough crew, in a fantasy setting.
A larger, more elaborate adventure that also involves hidden treasure and a long game of revenge.
Another short, vivid classic of adventure told with confident, direct storytelling.
